title: The training yard
blurb: An old soldier's practice yard. Hold a sword and a shield, see a blow coming, and get through a bout.
after: Every fight here is real time and every blow winds up. Most fights are won by not being where the blow lands, and the best are never started.
refines: Can players read a wind-up and block or step back? Does the bout feel fair? Do they find Give up when it goes badly?

npc_hal_brand.goal: keep an eye on the yard

things.name: practice sword
things.description: A wooden practice sword of ash, its edges rounded and its tip padded with leather.

things.name: wicker shield
things.description: A round shield of woven willow on a wooden rim, light and springy.

spars.says: Ha! Straight in, is it? Practice only, then.

steps.title: A practice yard
cards: …signal. This is the garrison's practice yard, a short walk from the city road. Hal, the arms-master, teaches anyone willing to sweat.
Fights here happen in real time, and they're real: a blow lands or it doesn't. Better to learn on wooden swords.

steps.title: The arms-master
cards: Go and talk to Hal, by the ring. Tell him you want to learn.

suggest.text: I'd like to learn how to fight.

steps.task: Tell Hal you want to learn

on_done.text: Learn? Good. Sword in your right hand, shield in your left. Here: practice ones. Nobody bleeds in my yard.

steps.done: A practice sword and a wicker shield, lent to you: yours to use, not to keep.
help: {Left-click} Hal, tell him you want to learn to fight, then press {Enter}.
Or press Type it for me on the card, then {Enter}.

playtest.say: I'd like to learn how to fight.

steps.title: Two hands
cards: You have two hands. Press {I} for Pack & gear: click the practice sword and choose Right hand; click the wicker shield and choose Left hand.
A sword like this takes one hand, so the other can hold a shield. A staff or a spear takes both.
steps.task: Press I: the sword in your right hand, the shield in your left
steps.done: Armed. {X} swaps what's in your hands, if you ever need to.
help: Press {I}. Find the practice sword and press Right hand; then the wicker shield and press Left hand.

steps.title: Swinging
cards: {Space} uses what's in your right hand: with a sword, a swing. It goes where you face and lands after a moment: that moment is the wind-up.
Walk up to a straw dummy and swing at it.
steps.task: Walk up to a dummy and press Space
steps.done: Every swing winds up first: yours, and everyone else's. That's your chance, and theirs.
help: Walk to one of the straw dummies, face it, and press {Space}.

steps.title: The shield
cards: {F} uses your left hand. With a shield there, hold {F} to raise it. It only stops blows from in front of you, so face what's coming.
steps.task: Hold F to raise your shield
steps.done: Let go of {F} and it comes down. You can't swing well with the shield up: choose your moment.

steps.title: A blow coming
cards: Now Hal will swing at you: slowly, it's practice. Watch the red mark over his head: that's his wind-up.
When it shows, raise your shield towards him ({F}) or step back out of reach. Walk up to Hal to begin.
steps.task: Walk up to Hal, then block or dodge one of his blows

do.text: On guard. I'll go slow. Watch the shoulder.

steps.done: That's the whole trick: see it coming, and don't be where it lands.
help: Walk right up to Hal. When the red mark shows over his head, hold {F} facing him, or step back.

steps.title: The bout
cards: Now hit back. Lower your shield, step in while he recovers from a swing, and press {Space}.
It's only practice: it ends when one of you is beaten. If it goes badly, press {T} and say you give up. There's no shame in that here.
steps.task: Finish the bout: hit back, or say you give up

on_done.text: Not bad. You'll live a week. If you get cut out there, Mother Brea at the inn will sew you up.

on_done.lead: Mother Brea at the inn patches up cuts.
on_done.said: Mother Brea at the inn will sew you up.

steps.done: Win or lose, you know how a fight goes now. A real one won't stop at 'enough': choose your fights.
help: Let go of {F}. When Hal has just swung, step in and press {Space}.
Or press {T} and type 'I give up'.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
